groups.title: Marine Salvage & Emergency Response
groups.summary: Marine salvage requires a different operating mindset from conventional construction.
groups.intro: Marine salvage requires a different operating mindset from conventional construction. Conditions are often uncertain, engineering information may be incomplete, assets may be damaged or unstable, and operational circumstances can change rapidly.

about.title: About XENOS MARINE
text: Xenos is a contracting firm specializing in the provision of comprehensive marine construction solutions, offshore heavy lifting, and marine salvage operations. With a commitment to excellence, safety, and innovation Xenos has successfully delivered high quality services across the marine industry. At Xenos, we recognize the extraordinary skill set possessed by skilled maritime veterans and the invaluable contributions they provide.

A Vision for the Future Together, Xenos LLC (SDVOSB) and T&T Salvage are redefining marine heavy lifting and salvage through their combined expertise and leadership. Xenos' strategic vision and broad industry experience, paired with T&T's decades of technical excellence and deep understanding of salvage operations, position Xenos Marine LLC as a leader in the field. Their dedication to innovation, sustainability, and operational precision ensures that Xenos Marine remains at the forefront of the industry, meeting the evolving needs of clients and setting new standards for success.
The strength of Xenos is our ability to bring multiple offshore disciplines together under a single execution strategy.
